The agent confirmed the details, noted the issue as urgent, and informed Yolanda that a representative would call her back at the start of business hours at 9 AM. The agent documented the urgent request and informed Akia that the team would contact them on the next business day, which is Saturday. The call ended with Akia confirming no further assistance was needed.

The agent collected the member's name, address, callback number, and clarified the nature of the work order as expedited. The user decided to confirm some details with the member before finalizing the work order description and ended the call.

The agent collected the emergency information and noted the request to pass along to the team for follow-up. The call ended before the agent could complete the conversation or confirm next steps.
